method: Offline broadband onset proposals followed by assistant visual review of all waveforms, spectrograms, and enlarged onset windows. Three overlap-triggered proposals refined against the first 14 ms of isolated snare block 4 (waveform correlations 0.959-0.970), then visually rechecked. No trained detector and no motor timestamps used as labels.

examples.notes: Waveform/spectrogram and attack window visually reviewed; snare-only timestamps, including mixtures. No auditory or independent human audit.
